dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - June 13, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Cardinals Outlast Twins, Yankees Take Down Blue Jays in Low-Scoring Affair**

The St. Louis Cardinals edged the Minnesota Twins 9-6, with Iván Herrera leading the charge. Herrera hit two home runs and drove in three runs, while Jordan Walker and Blaze Jordan also contributed with strong performances. On the mound, Matt Svanson earned the win with 1.2 innings of scoreless relief, striking out two without allowing a hit or walk.

In other action, the New York Yankees defeated the Toronto Blue Jays 3-1 behind a strong outing from Cam Schlittler, who went 7 innings, allowing one run on six hits and striking out seven. Paul Goldschmidt homered for the Yankees, while Kazuma Okamoto added a hit. The Blue Jays' Louis Varland took the loss.

The San Diego Padres dominated the Baltimore Orioles 9-3, with Samad Taylor hitting a home run and driving in three runs. Randy Vásquez earned the win for the Padres, going five innings and striking out five.

The Washington Nationals took down the Seattle Mariners 8-3, with Colt Emerson hitting a home run and driving in two runs. Alex Hoppe earned the win in relief for the Nationals, striking out two without allowing a hit or walk.

In a close game, the Pittsburgh Pirates edged the Miami Marlins 3-2, with Bubba Chandler pitching 5.2 innings and striking out six. Ryan O'Hearn had two hits for the Pirates, while Jake Mangum drove in a run.

The Cincinnati Reds beat the Arizona Diamondbacks 2-1, with Corbin Carroll hitting a home run and driving in a run. Michael Soroka earned the loss for the Diamondbacks, going seven innings and striking out seven.

The Cleveland Guardians defeated the Detroit Tigers 3-1, with Daniel Schneemann hitting a home run and driving in two runs. Joey Cantillo earned the win for the Guardians, going five innings and striking out four.

The Boston Red Sox took down the Texas Rangers 6-3, with Jarren Duran hitting a home run and driving in two runs. Ranger Suarez earned the win for the Red Sox, going five innings and striking out seven.

The Atlanta Braves defeated the New York Mets 3-1, with Michael Harris II hitting a home run and driving in a run. Sean Manaea earned the loss for the Mets, going six innings and striking out six.

The Los Angeles Dodgers dominated the Chicago White Sox 7-1, with Max Muncy hitting two home runs and driving in four runs. Yoshinobu Yamamoto earned the win for the Dodgers, going 8.1 innings and striking out seven.

The Houston Astros edged the Kansas City Royals 8-7, with Christian Walker hitting a home run and driving in three runs. Bryan King earned the win for the Astros, going two innings and striking out three.

The Philadelphia Phillies took down the Milwaukee Brewers 9-8 in a close game, with Jackson Chourio hitting two home runs and driving in four runs. Tim Mayza earned the win for the Phillies, going one inning and striking out three.

The Oakland Athletics defeated the Colorado Rockies 7-5, with Zack Gelof hitting a home run and driving in two runs. José Suarez earned the win for the Athletics, going five innings and striking out five.

The Chicago Cubs dominated the San Francisco Giants 6-1, with Pete Crow-Armstrong hitting a home run and driving in a run. Ben Brown earned the win for the Cubs, going five innings and striking out four.

The Los Angeles Angels defeated the Tampa Bay Rays 8-0, with Jose Siri hitting a home run and driving in two runs. José Soriano earned the win for the Angels, going five innings and striking out five.
